name: tex-path
description: Installs /etc/profile.d/texlive.sh so TeX Live binaries and documentation paths are available after tl-installer.

package:
cat > $DESTDIR/etc/profile.d/texlive.sh << EOF
# Begin texlive setup
TEXLIVE_PREFIX=/opt/texlive/2025
export TEXLIVE_PREFIX

pathappend \$TEXLIVE_PREFIX/texmf-dist/doc/info INFOPATH
pathappend \$TEXLIVE_PREFIX/bin/\$TEXARCH

TEXMFCNF=\$TEXLIVE_PREFIX/texmf-dist/web2c
export TEXMFCNF

# End texlive setup
EOF
